_about: Component spec for pos-markdown (style/pos-markdown.css + views/partials/forms/markdown.liquid + assets/js/pos-markdown.js). Built 2026-09-04 from already-shipped CSS (61 lines) that had no Tokens-panel spec, docs page, or nav wiring. Wraps the EasyMDE library (real npm dependency, easymde ^2.20.0, already bundled into assets/js/dependency-easyMde.js/style/dependency-easyMde.css — not a new external dependency), whose toolbar/editor/preview DOM is generated entirely by EasyMDE's own JS at runtime from a plain <textarea>. Real pre-existing gap found and fixed, same class of bug as File upload: init.liquid linked dependency-easyMde.css but never actually loaded dependency-easyMde.js or pos-markdown.js at all — .pos-markdown elements silently did nothing anywhere in the new DS until now. Fixed with a guarded dynamic import (only loads when a .pos-markdown element is actually present), consistent with how the upload dependency is already loaded in this same file. Per the same live-widget precedent established for File upload, the docs preview mounts a real, live EasyMDE editor (toolbar, live preview toggle, syntax highlighting all genuinely interactive) rather than a hand-approximated static mockup; real image-upload attempts fail gracefully since the preview has no real backend endpoint. No Variant/State toggle exists — EasyMDE manages its own internal interaction state (which toolbar buttons are active, preview on/off), which can't be simulated via a debug class; documented as a single static representative view, the same known limitation already accepted for Card/Feature card/File upload. Four uses of !important already exist in this component's CSS (pre-existing, not added by this pass) — flagged, not silently removed: EasyMDE's own bundled CSS sets competing border/radius rules directly on the same elements at equal or higher specificity, and removing !important without live verification risks silently breaking the actual visual override. Regenerate spec-markdown.liquid via the Node regen snippet (RULES.md §6.4) if this file changes. 2026-09-04: toolbar buttons previously inherited the toolbar's own text color (--pos-color-input-text) instead of an icon token now use --pos-color-content-icon-interactive at rest / --pos-color-interactive on hover, the standard icon-signals-interactivity pattern. Also styled EasyMDE's own .disabled-for-preview class (added to formatting buttons while the live preview is active, but shipped with zero matching CSS in the bundled dependency-easyMde.css — buttons looked fully clickable with no indication they currently do nothing) with --pos-color-content-icon-disabled + pointer-events: none. 2026-09-04: fixed the code-editor (CodeMirror) area rendering with a hardcoded white background/black text (EasyMDE's own bare .CodeMirror rule, specificity 0,1,0) regardless of theme — added background-color/color using --pos-color-input-background/--pos-color-input-text on the .EasyMDEContainer .CodeMirror selector (0,2,0, wins without !important, verified no competing higher-specificity EasyMDE rule targets the same properties). 2026-09-04: corrected the CodeMirror background/text fix from the same day — the input-specific tokens (--pos-color-input-background/-text) were wrong for the code-editor area; switched to the generic --pos-color-content-background/--pos-color-content-text tokens, confirmed via live dark-mode screenshot that the input tokens did not switch correctly. 2026-09-04 (3rd attempt): the plain (non-!important) background-color/color on .EasyMDEContainer .CodeMirror still did not visibly apply in the browser despite correct specificity math (0,2,0 vs EasyMDE bare .CodeMirror at 0,1,0, no competing !important found in dependency-easyMde.css) — escalated both properties to !important, matching the precedent already set on this exact selector for border-color/radius in the same rule block. 2026-09-04: fixed the active/hover toolbar button background — EasyMDE's own bundled CSS hardcodes #fcfcfc/#95a5a6 (background/border), invisible against a dark toolbar in dark/HC mode; overridden with --pos-color-highlight-background/--pos-color-input-frame. 2026-09-04: fixed a real selector bug in the disabled-for-preview fix from earlier the same day — checked dependency-easyMde.js directly and found the class actually lands on the toolbar container itself (toolbar_div), never on individual buttons, so .editor-toolbar button.disabled-for-preview never matched anything and no icon ever visibly grayed out. Corrected to .editor-toolbar.disabled-for-preview button:not(.active) — the :not(.active) exclusion keeps the preview-toggle button itself clickable so the user can still exit preview mode.
name: Markdown editor
description: A rich Markdown text editor (built on EasyMDE) with a formatting toolbar, live preview, syntax highlighting, and optional image upload.
whenToUse: Letting a user write long-form, formatted content (descriptions, articles, comments) using Markdown syntax with a visual toolbar.
Needing a live preview of the rendered Markdown, or drag-and-drop/paste image upload inline with the content.
whenNotToUse: A short, single-line text input — use Input instead.
Plain, unformatted multi-line text with no Markdown/preview/upload needs — use Textarea instead.
do: Trigger via new window.pos.modules.markdown({ container }) — never build or style EasyMDE's toolbar/preview markup by hand, it is entirely generated at runtime.
Provide a real presigned_upload object in production if image upload is needed — the upload endpoint is required for pasted/dropped images to actually save.
Set minlength/maxlength to match real validation needs — both are enforced on form submit via the built-in module.validate().
dont: Restyle EasyMDE's toolbar/editor beyond the color/radius tokens already applied in pos-markdown.css — its internal layout is controlled by the library, not this design system.
Rely on this component in a docs/demo context expecting real image uploads to succeed — without a real presigned_upload endpoint, the editor works but uploads fail.
accessibility: EasyMDE's toolbar buttons are keyboard-operable and carry their own accessible labels/titles.
Validation errors are separate <li> elements toggled via a class, not injected dynamically — verify they're associated with the field for screen reader users if customizing further.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the underlying <textarea> carrying the Markdown content.

props.name: presigned_upload
props.description: Presigned upload data (upload_url + upload_url_payload) for the inline image-upload feature.

props.name: value
props.description: Pre-filled Markdown content for the textarea.

props.name: minlength
props.description: Minimum character count, enforced on form submit.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum character count, enforced on form submit.

Toolbar button icon color at rest — the subdued icon-signals-interactivity pattern (RULES.md §4.10)
Toolbar button icon color on hover
Toolbar button icon color while the live preview is showing (EasyMDE's own .disabled-for-preview class, unstyled by its bundled CSS until now)
Active/hover toolbar button background — overrides EasyMDE's own hardcoded near-white background, which stayed white regardless of theme
